# PaperTiger v1.2.1 - Table of Contents

> A stateful mock Stripe server for testing Elixir applications

## GUIDES

- [README](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Examples
  - [Getting Started with PaperTiger](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/getting_started.md)

- Changelog
  - [Changelog](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [PaperTiger.Adapters.StripityStripe](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Adapters.StripityStripe.md): Syncs Stripe data from strippity_stripe database tables.
- [PaperTiger.AutomaticTax](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.AutomaticTax.md): Deterministic Stripe Tax helpers for PaperTiger's local test surface.
- [PaperTiger.BalanceTransactionHelper](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.BalanceTransactionHelper.md): Helper functions for creating balance transactions.
- [PaperTiger.BillingEngine](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.BillingEngine.md): Simulates Stripe's subscription billing lifecycle.
- [PaperTiger.Bootstrap](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Bootstrap.md): Bootstrap a worker to handle sync after start up.

- [PaperTiger.ChaosCoordinator](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.ChaosCoordinator.md): Unified chaos testing infrastructure for PaperTiger.
- [PaperTiger.ChaosHelpers](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.ChaosHelpers.md): Test helpers for chaos testing with PaperTiger.
- [PaperTiger.ChargeHelper](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.ChargeHelper.md): Creates Charge objects from PaymentIntents.
- [PaperTiger.Connect](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Connect.md): Request-scoped helpers for Stripe Connect behavior.
- [PaperTiger.DataSource](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.DataSource.md): Behaviour for an external data source that can preload PaperTiger stores.
- [PaperTiger.Hydrator](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Hydrator.md): Expands nested object references based on `expand[]` query parameters.
- [PaperTiger.Initializer](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Initializer.md): Loads initial data into PaperTiger stores on startup.
- [PaperTiger.List](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.List.md): Handles Stripe-style pagination for list endpoints.
- [PaperTiger.ListFilters](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.ListFilters.md): Shared helpers for Stripe-style list endpoint filtering.
- [PaperTiger.MandateHelper](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.MandateHelper.md): Builds and stores Mandate objects for successful intent flows.

- [PaperTiger.Plug.APIChaos](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plug.APIChaos.md): Plug middleware that injects chaos into API requests.
- [PaperTiger.Search](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Search.md): Shared Stripe-style search support.
- [PaperTiger.Store](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Store.md): Shared behavior for all ETS-backed resource stores.
- [PaperTiger.StripityStripeHackney](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.StripityStripeHackney.md): HTTP module for stripity_stripe that enables PaperTiger sandbox isolation.
- [PaperTiger.SyncAdapter](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.SyncAdapter.md): Behavior for syncing Stripe data into PaperTiger stores.
- [PaperTiger.TelemetryHandler](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.TelemetryHandler.md): Handles telemetry events and creates Stripe events + delivers webhooks.
- [PaperTiger.UserAdapter](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.UserAdapter.md): Behavior for resolving user information from billing customers.
- [PaperTiger.UserAdapters.AutoDiscover](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.UserAdapters.AutoDiscover.md): Auto-discovers user schema patterns and extracts user information.

- Public API
  - [PaperTiger](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.md): PaperTiger - A stateful mock Stripe server for testing.

- Resources
  - [PaperTiger.Resources.Account](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Resources.Account.md): Handles legacy Connect Account endpoints.

- Webhooks
  - [PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.md): Manages webhook event delivery to registered endpoints.
  - [PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Adapter](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Adapter.md): Behaviour for delivering a signed webhook request.
  - [PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.HTTPAdapter](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.HTTPAdapter.md): Default `PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Adapter` — performs the HTTP POST
itself using `Req`. This is the historical PaperTiger behavior and the
adapter in effect when `:webhook_delivery_adapter` is not configured.
  - [PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Request](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Request.md): A fully-prepared webhook delivery request handed to a
`PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Adapter`.
  - [PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Response](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Response.md): The successful result of a `PaperTiger.WebhookDelivery.Adapter.deliver/1`
call.

- Testing
  - [PaperTiger.Test](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Test.md): Test helpers for running PaperTiger tests concurrently.
  - [PaperTiger.TestHelpers](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.TestHelpers.md): ExUnit test helpers for PaperTiger.
  - [PaperTiger.TestTokens](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.TestTokens.md): Pre-defined Stripe test tokens that are always available in PaperTiger.

- Internal
  - [PaperTiger.Clock](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Clock.md): Manages time for PaperTiger. Three modes
  - [PaperTiger.Error](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Error.md): Stripe-compatible error responses.
  - [PaperTiger.Idempotency](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Idempotency.md): Implements Stripe's idempotency mechanism to prevent duplicate requests.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.Auth](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.Auth.md): Authenticates requests using Stripe-compatible API key verification.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.CORS](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.CORS.md): Handles CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) headers for browser-based testing.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.ConnectContext](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.ConnectContext.md): Applies Stripe Connect request context from the `Stripe-Account` header.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.GetFormBody](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.GetFormBody.md): Parses form-encoded body params for GET requests.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.Idempotency](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.Idempotency.md): Handles Stripe-compatible idempotency key processing.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.RequestLogger](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.RequestLogger.md): Captures inbound API requests for test assertions.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.Sandbox](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.Sandbox.md): Plug that extracts test namespace from HTTP headers for sandbox isolation.
  - [PaperTiger.Plugs.UnflattenParams](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Plugs.UnflattenParams.md): Converts Stripe's form-encoded nested parameters into proper nested maps.
  - [PaperTiger.Resource](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Resource.md): Shared utilities for resource handlers.
  - [PaperTiger.Router](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Router.md): HTTP router for PaperTiger Stripe mock server.
  - [PaperTiger.Router.Macros](https://paper-tiger.hexdocs.pm/PaperTiger.Router.Macros.md): Macros for generating Stripe resource routes.
